title: Arsenal and Dortmund headline a Champions League night with no margin
summary: The Champions League league phase reaches matchday five on 24 and 25 November with 18 fixtures. Arsenal, third and having conceded only three goals in four European games, host Borussia Dortmund; Manchester City welcome Napoli and former midfielder Kevin De Bruyne; Real Madrid meet PSV; Paris Saint-Germain, perfect so far, face Roma. Liverpool travel to Club Brugge, Bayern Munich visit Lille, and Mauricio Pochettino takes Manchester United to Sporting CP after his losing start in the Premier League.
